introduction_transcript: Welcome to Journey Six, Lesson Three: Complete the Quality, Responsibility, and Readiness Review. Bring forward the finished artifact, the correction you made, and the evidence you saved in Lesson Two. Today, you will check whether that package is ready to be shown and explained responsibly. We will use the READY Quality Review: Relevant, Evidenced, Accountable, Designed, and Yours. Relevant asks whether the work serves the need in your approved charter. Evidenced asks whether the claims, sources, and tests support what you say. Accountable asks who owns the result and how a person can review and correct it. Designed asks whether people can use and understand the work, including its accessibility. Yours asks whether you can explain your judgment and describe the contribution of AI truthfully. This quality review is different from the earlier READY Automation Screen. A beautiful presentation does not make an untested result complete. You will identify a weakness, make a proportionate correction, and check the revised version. Then you will finalize your Responsible Practice Statement in your own words and write a clear disclosure of what AI actually contributed. Keep unresolved issues visible. If a remaining limitation makes the intended use unsuitable, narrow the use or continue the correction. AI can help you inspect the package, but it does not award certification or take responsibility for your decisions. Open the connected workbook, keep your evidence nearby, and let us review the work with care. Let's begin.
